title: President Order 4 Governors Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: President Order 4 Governors Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT ORDER 4 OF 2002, Governors Salaries, Allowances and Privileges
(Amendment) Order, 2002
PRESIDENT ORDER 4 OF 2002, Governors Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges (Amendment) Order, 2002
An order further
to amend the Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th May, 2002]
F. No. 2(2)/2002‑Pub.,
dated 8‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Order promulgated by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Governors'
Salaries, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

PRESIDENT ORDER 4 OF 2002, Governors Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges (Amendment) Order, 2002
An order further
to amend the Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th May, 2002]
F. No. 2(2)/2002‑Pub.,
dated 8‑5‑2002.‑‑The following Order promulgated by the
President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of Article 3,
P.O. No.5 of 1975.‑‑In the Governors Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges Order, 1975 (P.O. No.5 of 1975), hereinafter referred to as the said
Order, in Article 3, for the words "one hundred and fifty‑six
thousand rupees" the word "four hundred and eighty thousand
rupees" shall be substituted.
